Question Choices: Select. In a box plot, Q1 = 12, Median = 18, Q3 = 28. What percentage of the data does the box represent, from 12 and 28? ~~15% | 25% | 50% | 100%~~
Hints: Q1 to Q3 spans two of the four quartile portions.
Solution: The box extends from Q1 to Q3 and represents the middle half, or50%, of the distribution. This describes the quartile portion; ties at the boundaries can change the exact number of observations in a closed interval.

Question Choices: Which is TRUE about a box plot with no outliers?   (A) Whiskers show quartiles   (B) Box shows full range   (C) Whiskers show min and max   (D) Median is outside the box
Hints: Read the whisker endpoints, not the box edges.
Solution: With no outliers, the whisker endpoints are the minimum and maximum: C. Box edges markQ1 andQ3; the median line lies inside the box.

Solution: TRUE. Q1=9 is the first quartile, marking the boundary of the lowest quartile portion. The exact fraction of observations at or below a tied or interpolated quartile depends on the data and quartile convention.
